title: tests: stabilize manifest-skip all-platforms test in CI
body:
Mirror k8s-pause with `skopeo copy --all` when not using CI registry cache; use manifest rm and registry cert options for the rest of the test.

comments.body:
> Given that in CI, we set "CI_USE_REGISTRY_CACHE=1" in the environment, I'm having trouble seeing what this changes in the CI environment.

The commit message should mention that but this is for the packit/testing farm tests which cannot do the cache like we have in the github lima VMs.

I think you may be able to reproduce this locally as well.
I've restarted the failed tests, they looked flakey.
